identity.title: Keep one C3D byte identity after load

origin.summary: The C3D viewer kept source metadata from load but reopened the mutable path for point, row, profile, full-map, and inspection sampling.

state.current_summary: C3DHeightGrid now owns the exact raw samples parsed at load; every grid read and Viewer density/inspection resampling path uses that immutable snapshot, with focused, affected-product, build, and refreshed R0 verification passing.

claims.text: A C3D file replaced after load can cause one open grid to combine old identity/statistics with new sample bytes.

problem.impact: Inspection metrics and evidence could be internally inconsistent with the source SHA-256 attached to the loaded item.

criteria.text: Point, row-range, line-profile, and full height-map reads use only the original loaded samples.
Viewer render-density and inspection resampling preserve the original loaded identity and samples without reopening the path.
Focused C3D regression, affected product verification, and Debug/Release builds pass.
The active backlog, handoff, documentation index, and issue ledger record the behavior and its remaining memory boundary.

context.summary: Render-density changes now derive a view from the loaded sample instead of reopening the current path.
Plane, flatness, Gap/Flush, and Volume resampling now derives from the loaded sample.
The focused headless verifier covers every grid read shape and density resampling after same-size content and header replacement.

artifacts.summary: Debug/Release build logs, focused and affected verification reports, and refreshed Wide/Compact R0 validation output.

evidence.observation: The grid recorded SHA-256/statistics at load, while its point, row, profile, full-map methods and four Viewer inspection paths subsequently reopened SourcePath; same-path replacement could therefore mix identities.

Release loaded-snapshot/profile verification passed 14/14, covering point, row, profile, full-map, and density views after source content/header replacement; source search found no remaining C3DHeightGrid.Load(c3dSample.SourcePath, ...) call in Viewer.

Debug and Release solution builds completed with zero warnings and errors; affected Workbench/Runner checks passed 113/113; Wide and Compact R0 ValidateOnly both passed with refreshed nine-input hashes and launched no application.

The verified finding matrix, immutable snapshot ownership, verification, R0 refresh, remaining memory boundary, and next priorities are linked from the current master backlog, handoff, next-chat prompt, and documentation map; changed-document local links passed 24/24.

events.summary: Replaced mutable path reopens with immutable loaded-sample reads and density views, added focused CI coverage, and passed the required verification and documentation gates.
